title: Which Sonic character are you? Sonic the Hedgehog quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Sonic the Hedgehog quiz: answer 12 questions to see whether you are Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Amy, Shadow, Rouge, Cream or Silver. No sign-up.
lede: Fast and free like Sonic, clever like Tails or a loner like Shadow? Answer 12 questions about your habits and find your match among eight Sonic the Hedgehog characters.
about: Sonic's friends and rivals each have a clear personality: Sonic lives for freedom and speed, Tails builds machines, Knuckles guards the Master Emerald, Amy never gives up on love, Shadow keeps everyone at a distance, Rouge hunts jewels, Cream minds her manners and Silver came from the future to change it.

This quiz scores your answers for all eight and shows your match and how close the others came. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by SEGA; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: Who are the main Sonic characters?
faq.a: Sonic, Tails and Knuckles are the classic trio. Amy Rose, Shadow, Rouge, Cream and Silver joined in later games, and Dr. Eggman is the main villain.

faq.q: Is Shadow a hero or a villain?
faq.a: He started as a rival in Sonic Adventure 2 and has fought on both sides since. He is driven by a promise from his past, which is why he often works alone.

faq.q: Why isn't Dr. Eggman a result?
faq.a: This quiz sticks to Sonic's friends and rivals. Eggman fans can take it as a challenge to land on Shadow or Rouge.

sonic.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
sonic.body: Free, fast and fearless. You can't stand waiting, you do what feels right and you are first to help when it matters. You might want to slow down once in a while.

tails.name: Miles "Tails" Prower
tails.body: Clever, loyal and always building something. You solve problems with your head, stick by your best friend and are braver than you think.

knuckles.name: Knuckles the Echidna
knuckles.body: Strong, honest and protective. You take your duties seriously and will guard what matters with everything you have, even if you sometimes trust the wrong person.

amy.name: Amy Rose
amy.body: Cheerful, determined and full of heart. You know what you want and chase it without giving up, and you stay optimistic when everyone else has stopped believing.

shadow.name: Shadow the Hedgehog
shadow.body: Serious, intense and driven by purpose. You keep your feelings to yourself and work best alone, but you never forget a promise.

rouge.name: Rouge the Bat
rouge.body: Stylish, witty and good at getting what you want. You like nice things and a bit of danger, and under the teasing you are a better friend than you let on.

cream.name: Cream the Rabbit
cream.body: Sweet, polite and kind. You treat everyone with good manners, love a quiet afternoon with friends and are steadier than people expect.

silver.name: Silver the Hedgehog
silver.body: Earnest, idealistic and always thinking ahead. You want to fix what is broken and change how the future turns out, even if you are a little naive about how.
